fact: Rays of Hope Ministries, through its Teaching at the Right Level programme, handed 48 tablets to the Blantyre District Education Office to collect data on learners' performance in 48 public primary schools, replacing visits by zonal EMIS officers to every school, with 20 more schools to follow; this is an NGO programme's data collection, not a national EMIS.
title: Blantyre gets tablets for collecting education data
